title.en: The servant's praise and plea for guidance

summary.en: Al-Fatihah teaches praise of Allah, exclusive worship, seeking help, and asking to be guided to the straight path.

title.en: The qualities of those who receive guidance

summary.en: The opening passage describes the people who benefit from the Book: those with taqwa, faith in the unseen, prayer, giving, belief in revelation, and certainty in the Hereafter.

title.en: Allah's life, knowledge, authority, and preservation

summary.en: Ayat al-Kursi magnifies Allah's oneness, life, sustaining power, ownership, knowledge, authority, and preservation of the heavens and earth.
Surah al-Ikhlas declares Allah's absolute oneness, self-sufficiency, and incomparability.
Surah al-Falaq teaches the believer to seek Allah's protection from created evil, darkness, sorcery, and envy.
Surah an-Nas teaches the believer to seek refuge in Allah, Lord, King, and God of mankind, from the evil of whispering temptation.
